sources: exact-offer-cost-route-baseline-2026-09-03.json: source of every row carried forward unchanged below (the ten archived cn-direct rows, the four compression rows, and the eight retired watch-roll rows). None of those were re-read today.

AliExpress item pages read 2026-09-09 on aliexpress.us in the US-priced view: three supplier listings back all nine bamboo lighting offers. 1005007626643748 (US id 3256807440328996), 1005009170603754 (US id 3256808984289002) and 1005010458579497 (US id 3256810272264745). Shipping method, cost, delivery window and arrival distribution read from each listing shipping dialog; voltage and base type read from each expanded specification table.
DSers My Products, read 2026-09-09: supplyProductId and the mapped cost range for each of the nine, taken from the mapping record rather than the storefront card.

notes.2026-09-09: Nine bamboo lighting rows added. Only TWO of them are approved for the United States: hand-woven-bamboo-pendant-light and plug-in-bamboo-sconce-swing-arm, whose listings state Voltage 90-260V. The other seven all come off listing 1005009170603754, whose specification table states Voltage 220 V, and are held in VOLTAGE_HOLD_CATALOG_OFFERS rather than approved. Their cost and route rows are kept here so that releasing them needs a supplier confirmation rather than a fresh audit. See the hold comment in app/lib/launch-catalog.js.
notes.2026-09-09-routes: All three listings quote the same carrier and price into the United States: AliExpress Selection Standard at $1.99, CN-direct. The two delivery windows differ (Sep 15-20 at 84.0% within 10 days for 1005007626643748; Sep 16-21 at 87.5% within 12 days for the other two, which returned an identical distribution). tracked:true is carried from the carrier identity recorded in the 2026-09-01 baseline, NOT from a tracking number observed today - that needs a placed order.
notes.2026-09-09-fx: Fee rates, planning FX and checkout shipping carried forward from 2026-09-03 unchanged. Nothing about the Shopify delivery profile was re-read today.

derivedFrom.note: Bundle row. Not an independently quoted supplier offer: every figure is the sum of the three component rows in this same file, because the kit is fulfilled as three separate DSers orders. stockOnSupplier is the MINIMUM of the three components, not a sum - the kit cannot be assembled more times than its scarcest part allows, and on 2026-08-25 that part is the cable organizer case at 19 units. The US shipping figure is lower than the CA one because the packing cube set ships free to the United States. Re-derive whenever a component row changes.

derivedFrom.note: Grey. Per-SKU cost was not read individually: the DSers product card quotes the whole product as USD 26.69-27.94 (shown alongside as CA$37.03-38.76), and every SKU here carries the TOP of the USD range. CORRECTED 2026-08-27: this row first carried 27.69, derived by dividing the CAD top by the 1.4 planning rate. Stock is per-SKU and was read on 2026-08-27; the file-level supplierStockObservedOn refers to the carried-forward rows, not these.
